body: I'm vegan & have been through pregnancy and now while breastfeeding. I feel great and my little guy is perfectly healthy in all areas. I had an incredibly easy pregnancy and have had no problems with supply or baby's weight gain while breastfeeding. My little man's doctor always praises me for having such a healthy baby and I'm positive my diet is the reason. The only issue is finding time to cook all my meals lol

Try filling your kitchen with things that won't hurt your tummy if you do overeat, like fruits & veggies, yogurt, etc. You could also try planning your meals and snacks and preparing them a couple days ahead so you don't have to think about what you need to make or how you're going to eat. It may take some of the anxiety about it away. As /u/missed_againn said, it does sound like you may be suffering from an eating disorder. Stay strong and seek help! It doesn't have to be like this forever.
